title: Reading Drill — Studying skate park use — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Studying skate park use — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The park designer in Millcross received an old report about users waiting rather than sharing the narrowest ramp. The report compared wait time before each turn, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the timed observations rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered five weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include group lessons. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a one-way entry pattern as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
